question: According to Census of India 2011, the top three most populated states are:

options.text: Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Himanchal Pradesh
West Bengal, Bihar and Andhra Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Bihar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:-**

 
 
• It is the most populated state in India with a population of over 199 million.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra:-**
 
 
• It has a population of over 112 million.
 
 
 
• **Bihar:-**
 
 
• It has a population of over 103 million.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh:-**

 
 
• It is a northern Indian state with a population of around 7 million.
 
 
 
• **Goa:-**
 
 
• It is one of the smallest states in India with a population of around 1.5 million and is not among the top three most populated states.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh:-**
 
 
• It is one of the larger states in India with a population of over 49 million but is not among the top three most populated states.
